name: dcompact
description: Deterministic, rule-based memory for coding agents — no model in the extraction path.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.gen:vectors: rm -rf .vectors-build && tsc --noEmit false --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --outDir .vectors-build --rootDir . scripts/gen-vectors.ts && node .vectors-build/scripts/gen-vectors.js; status=$?; rm -rf .vectors-build; exit $status
